text: ……　これ　＊じゃ　ないわー　てに　いれたら　ぜったい　とりかえてよねっ！

structure.jp: ……　これ　＊じゃ　ないわー
ぜったい　とりかえてよねっ！
structure.en: you'd better trade it with me, OK?

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'once' that happens. てにいれたら = 'if you get one'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て at the end of a sentence asks someone to do something; よね pushes them to agree. とりかえてよね = 'trade with me, all right?'.

patterns.name: 〜ではない
patterns.explanation: じゃない is the everyday spoken form of ではない, 'is not'. ＊じゃない = 'is not a ＊'.
